verdict.rationale: The CLI documents `skills init [name]` to scaffold a new SKILL.md template, and the referenced Agent Skills spec defines the required YAML-frontmatter format with a `skills-ref validate` step. A `skill-creator` skill is installable from vercel-labs/agent-skills, and the CLI auto-switches to non-interactive mode when driven by a coding agent, so an agent can follow the project's own template and spec. Missing for 10: no documented content or workflow for the skill-creator meta-skill, no explicit packaging/publish step beyond hosting in a git repo or URL, and no hands-on evidence of an agent authoring and packaging a skill end to end.
